```{r}
#| message: false

library(ggplot2) # For making data viz
library(dplyr) # Data manipulation
library(janitor) # clean names
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth) # gives "world" below
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(leaflet) # interactive map
library(maps)
library(gt)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

fd <- read.csv("crime.csv") |> 
  clean_names()

## Let's just take a sample of these data
set.seed(19823) # setting the seed ensures our sample will be the same. 
fd_sample <- fd |> 
  sample_n(size = 100)
```

```{r}
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
states <- st_as_sf(map("state", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))
counties <- st_as_sf(map("county", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))
counties <- subset(counties, grepl("colorado", counties$ID))

p <- ggplot(data = world) + 
  geom_sf() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA) + 
  geom_sf(data = counties, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(data = fd, aes(x = geo_lon, y = geo_lat)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-110, -100), ylim = c(35, 45), expand = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Create n most common crime categories table
top_n <- fd |> 
  group_by(offense_category_id) |> 
  summarize(total_crimes = n()) |> # count(*)
  arrange(desc(total_crimes)) |> 
  gt()
```

::: {.card title="Facet The Plot"}

```{r}
top_n
```

::: {.card title="Leaflet Visualization"}

```{r}
leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  setView(lng = -104.98470000, lat = 39.73915000, zoom = 10) |> 
  addMarkers(data = fd_sample, lng = ~geo_lon, lat = ~geo_lat, 
             popup = ~offense_category_id)  
```

::: {.card-body}
Here is a leaflet visualization of the same data. Notice that you can zoom in and out
within the visulation itself. You can also change the default zoom level in the setView 
function above.

:::
:::

```{r}
#| title: Top Five Crimes Only

top_5_crimes <- fd |> 
  count(offense_category_id) |> 
  arrange(desc(n)) |> 
  top_n(5) |> 
  pull(offense_category_id)

top_5_df <- fd |> 
  filter(offense_category_id %in% top_5_crimes) |> 
  mutate(reported_month = month(mdy_hm(reported_date), label = T),
         reported_year = year(mdy_hm(reported_date))) |> 
  group_by(reported_year, reported_month) |> 
  summarize(total_crimes = n()) |> 
  ungroup()

p <- ggplot(data = top_5_df,
            aes(x = reported_month, y = total_crimes, group = reported_year,
                colour = as.factor(reported_year)))
p + geom_line() +
  labs(color = "Year",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Total Crimes") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_bw()
```
